title: Workshop on Emerging and Immersive Visual Media
summary:
Organized by Prof. Wen-Hsiao Peng and hosted by the APSIPA Taipei Local Chapter and H&J Global Chair Program, the workshop covered Emerging and Immersive Visual Media: Hardware, Compression, and 3D/4D Representation.
Topics included spatial-temporal multimodal Gaussian splatting, video-coding hardware, post-training quantization for overfitted image compression, and neural coding of 3D/4D multimedia representations.
